name: A typed prompt opens into its image
looks: A plain search-style input holds a short typed prompt on a black field; it cross-fades and scales up into the full generated cinematic image the prompt described, the same prompt text now sitting as a small caption pill at the bottom of the frame.
build: Input bar is a fixed small element; on the cut, it scales (`1 -> fills frame`) while cross-fading into the final image, 300-400ms, power2.out. The prompt text itself doesn't change, just repositions from the input's centre to a caption pill at the bottom edge.
sound: A soft whoosh under the scale-up, a quiet settle as the image fills the frame.
prompt: Hold on a short typed prompt in a plain input, then scale it up until it opens into the full image it describes, filling the frame, letting the same prompt text resettle as a small caption at the bottom so the viewer can always trace the image back to its exact words.
